title: pm-dispatch protocol: the hourly CI card refresh now also returns `pm:blocked` to `pm:queue` (PR #24305), but SKILL.md and state-machine.md name only the unlock scan, and call the `Blocked-by:` marker undecorated
body:
**Filing gate ①**: agent-read protocol text made incomplete by a landed change, the follow-up a landing owes (「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」). **Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` seat (owner of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`), in one Tier S PR. Lane and grade are triage's. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023) · `sunhaolin` · `session_01VwoC2RxFfgzY2eXuC7Xo6g`, as #24278's dispatching seat. Its two contract reviews named this gap: `6249085305` ③ and `6249501215` ③. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What changed on `main`

PR #24305 (#24278) landed as `2b7fc52c3`. When `.github/workflows/scheduled-full-run-card.yml` refreshes the hourly full-run card while the card carries `pm:blocked`, `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` swaps `pm:blocked` for `pm:queue`, but only when ALL of these hold:
- every `Blocked-by:` target the card names (body or comments) is a closed card in this repository;
- no line-initial `Unlock-action:` line is present;
- the card is unassigned.

A cross-repo target never releases the card, even when it is closed. The `Blocked-by:` reader is the half-state patrol's own, imported from `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.

## The two protocol sentences this leaves short (on `origin/main` `2b7fc52c3`)

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈状态模型〉, the `pm:blocked` row: 「等上游:选择期跳过,#N 关闭时由解锁扫描放回」. The unlock scan is no longer the only returner: the hourly card's refresh is a second, narrower one.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md`, the `pm:blocked` section: 「正典标记 = 行首 `Blocked-by: #N`(跨仓 `owner/repo#N`)、无装饰」. The reader both returners share accepts a bullet and bold or backtick decoration (`DIRECTIVE_PREFIX` in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, by ruling C on #10102), and live markers are decorated (#23885 comment `6215815177`: `- **Blocked-by: #23908.** …`). "Undecorated" is the spelling to write; the sentence reads as the only spelling read.

## Premises, each with a re-check

- `git show origin/main:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md | grep -c "解锁扫描放回"` → 1. Control: `grep -c "pm:blocked"` → hits.
- `git show origin/main:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md | grep -n "正典标记"` → 1 hit (L24). Control: `grep -c "Unlock-action"` → 1.
- `git show origin/main:scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs | grep -c "export function staleBlockVerdict"` → 1. Control: `grep -c "fileOrRefreshCard"` → hits.

## Target

- One clause in each place. Name the hourly card's refresh as a second returner, under its narrower rule: every target is a closed local card, no `Unlock-action:` line, no assignee, and never on a cross-repo target. Say that "undecorated" is the canonical spelling to write, while the shared reader also accepts decorated lines.
- ⛔ No behaviour change and no gate.
- The skill line ratchet (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`) applies to SKILL.md, and new text pays for itself with removed text.
- `check:pm-skill-id-lint` forbids issue numbers in the skill's operative text. So the clause names the workflow and the module, never this card or #24278.

## Dedupe

- REST enumeration of the 1000 most recently updated objectstack items (539 issues, back to 2026-10-14T09:24Z), grepped for `undecorated`, `无装饰`, `解锁扫描放回` or `returner` beside `state-machine` or `blocked-by`: 4 hits, all tenancy-refactor cards (#15204, #15211, #15212, #15213), none on this subject. Control: #24278 was in the scan.
- MCP `search_issues` returned 0 for this subject. Its control query, which must hit #24278, also returned 0, so that instrument's zero is not a reading.

Dedupe words: pm:blocked second returner hourly refresh; Blocked-by canonical undecorated decorated reader; state-machine unlock scan only returner.
